# Gemini CLI Migration Desk

Gemini CLI Migration Desk imports repositories, CLI configs, extension inventories, rollout owners, and policy notes, then turns migration risk into a signed evidence packet.

Website: https://geminiclimigrationdesk.space/
Docs pattern reference: https://github.com/clauxel/MiroFish
Primary keyword: Gemini CLI migration audit
Type: SaaS
Default plan: Team

Public boundary: docs-only repository; no production source code or secrets.
